gameDescriptionHtml:
LIBERATE A RAVAGED WORLD:

In Dragonkin: The Banished, immerse yourself in a world corrupted by dragon blood, where evil creatures emerge from the bowels of the earth. Play as one of the legendary hero classes, driven by a singular mission: to hunt down and annihilate the dragon creatures. Each battle brings you closer to your goal of finding and eliminating the Dragon Lords.

Game Features

  • JOIN THE DRAGONKIN ADVENTURE IN CO-OP: Experience the Dragonkin adventure with your friends in online co-op mode for up to 4 players. From your arrival in the City of Montescail to the endgame activities, the entire Dragonkin adventure can be played cooperatively. Between missions, the City of Montescail serves as your hub where you can meet other players. Each player has a role to play in improving the city.
  • FOUR HEROES READY TO HUNT: Each hero has developed their own abilities and fighting techniques for facing the dragons. As you progress, your character, gear, Wyrmling and Ancestral Grid evolve. The Tracker: As the best hunter in her clan, she uses her prey to develop her skills and improve her arsenal. Any monsters that escape her arrows, blades or traps will succumb to the poisons she concocts. The Barbarian: Now that he is dragon-blooded, half-man, half-monster, his supernatural strength and ice powers, combined with his legendary rage, allow him to defeat the toughest enemies. The Oracle: Transformed by the blood of the blue dragon, she uses her electric dragon powers precisely, and can amplify them with the help of her visions. The Knight: Trained in combat, he wields the fire lance with unmatched skill. His unwavering faith in the Eternal and his unfailing determination make him impervious to dragon corruption. He stands as the light that will banish the darkness!
  • A UNIQUE UPGRADE MECHANISM: Discover the Ancestral Grid of skills, a brand new mechanism for transforming your character into a legendary fighter with unique powers. Acquire skills as loot from battles, and strategically place them in the grid alongside numerous modifiers. Optimize each slot to increase your power. Each hero has their own grid, offering a phenomenal number of skill and modifier combinations.
  • A WORLD TO DISCOVER: Fight the dragon creatures and journey across the world of Dragonkin. There are jungles, ancient islands, toxic swamps, plains, glaciers, arid volcanoes and more, waiting to be explored. Your quest will reveal the riches of this world, where each region has its own culture and history. You will also encounter unique monsters, each with distinct abilities and elements (Ice, Poison, Fire, Electricity) and resources which can upgrade your hero.
  • A CITY TO DEVELOP THROUGHOUT YOUR ADVENTURE: Nestled in the heart of the mountains, sheltered from dragons, lies a great city: the last bastion of humanity. This city grows and evolves according to your decisions and discoveries. As you progress, you can choose priorities for its development. Upgrade your buildings, welcome new residents, and discover additional equipment and services that will help you transform this refuge into a true haven for humanity.
